design_principles: Observed measurements, normalized derived values, and traditional graphology interpretations are separate layers.
Anything computable with classical/local computation is a free-compute feature.
Static-image darkness or thickness must never be represented as direct physical pen pressure.
Every measurement carries confidence, sample count, method version, and provenance.
Traditional graphology dimensions are explicitly interpretive and not validated psychological scores.
Online-sensor features are separate from static-image features.

SRC_GRAPH_ML.use: Seven classic offline graphology measurements, extraction logic, legacy bands.

SRC_HBPA.use: Related seven-feature graphology pipeline and preprocessing.

SRC_CROWS.use: Baseline, slant, margin, line-space, word-space algorithms and categories.

SRC_JJSHAY.use: Signature/handwriting statistical features and comparison concepts.

SRC_OCRPREP.use: Deskew/deslant/segmentation plus zoning, projections, crossings, Hu moments and profiles.

SRC_IMG2LINES.use: Handwritten line segmentation using Otsu, projection profiles, peaks/valleys.

SRC_WRITER.use: Wavelet, LBP, GLCM/CSLBCoP, LTP, frequency texture features.

SRC_SIG.use: Offline signature feature representation / learned embeddings.

SRC_BDA.use: Online handwriting kinematic, dynamic, spatial, temporal and composite features plus statistics.
